info.title: HerCare API
info.description:
Backend for HerCare Women, a free period tracker inside the DBI app.

**Who signs in.** Users are DBI users: send the token DBI gave them as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. HerCare has no passwords of its own for users. The admin signs in with `POST /admin/auth/login` and gets a separate admin token. The two kinds of token do not work on each other's routes.

**Envelope.** Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`. Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...] } }`.

**Dates** are plain calendar dates, `YYYY-MM-DD`, never timestamps. Times of day are `HH:MM` in the user's local time. Send `?date=` (the phone's local date) wherever it is accepted.

**Estimates.** Predicted dates are always estimates and are never stored as history.

Guides: docs/mobile-integration-guide.md, docs/sync-guide.md, docs/estimate-rule.md, docs/admin-panel-guide.md.

delete.summary: Permanently delete all of the user's HerCare data
delete.description: Deletes every HerCare record of this user (the DBI account is not touched). Cannot be undone. After this, `sync` returns `erasedAt`: any phone that last synced before that must wipe its local copy. Still works when HerCare is switched off.

post.description: The same start date twice is refused (409 DUPLICATE_PERIOD, edit the existing one). An overlap is refused with 409 OVERLAPPING_PERIOD until the user confirms and you resend with `confirmOverlap: true`. A period can be at most 20 days; dates can be at most one day ahead of the server's UTC date.

patch.description: Only this record changes. Send `endDate: null` to clear the end date. The same duplicate and overlap rules apply as when logging.

get.summary: The next-period estimate
get.description: Computed from the recorded periods by the rule in docs/estimate-rule.md. It is ALWAYS an estimate. A phone that works offline must implement the same rule; docs/estimate-test-vectors.json lets you check it.

get.summary: The notifications the phone should schedule
get.description: Computed fresh from the CURRENT period history every time, so an edited or deleted period can never leave a stale reminder. After any change to periods or reminder settings (and on app start), cancel the phone's old notifications and schedule this list. Times are the user's local time; the server does no time-zone conversion.

patch.summary: Turn a reminder on or off, pause, snooze, or change its time
patch.description: Settings that do not apply to a type are refused: `leadDays` and `timeOfDay` for period; `timeOfDay` for daily_log; `times` (up to 12, HH:MM) for hydration. `snoozeDays` 1 to 30 skips today and the following days; 0 or null cancels a snooze. A hydration reminder cannot be turned on without times.

userToken.description: The token DBI issued to the signed-in user (its `id` claim is the user id). HS256.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code. See the error table in docs/mobile-integration-guide.md.

details.description: Present on validation errors: a list of { field, message }. Some conflicts add an object.

durationDays.description: Days from start to end inclusive; null while no end date is set

confirmOverlap.description: Send true after the user confirms a 409 OVERLAPPING_PERIOD warning

estimated.description: Always true. Show it as an estimate.

basis.description: Where the cycle length came from

tooLittleHistory.description: True until two usable cycles are recorded

cycleDay.description: Day 1 is the first day of the last period

type.description: "predicted" days are estimates; actual days always win

SyncChanges.description: At most 500 records per list per request. Unknown keys are ignored.

SyncRequest.description: Everything is optional. An empty body just pulls.

server.description: On "stale": the server's newer version, which the phone must adopt

hasMore.description: Call again with the new cursor until false

epoch.description: Identifies this copy of the data. Store it and send it back.

resyncRequired.description: True when the epoch you sent is not the server's: reset your cursor and send ALL local data

changes.description: What changed on the server, same record shapes as the request, plus updatedAt (server time) and deleted flags

CountOrHidden.description: A number, or the string "<5" when the real number is 1 to 4 (hidden to protect privacy)

Error400.description: The request is not valid. `details` lists each problem.

details.message: startDate must be a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format

Error403.description: This kind of DBI account may not use HerCare (when the operators have restricted it)

error.message: This kind of account cannot use HerCare

Error409.description: A conflict. The code says which: DUPLICATE_PERIOD, OVERLAPPING_PERIOD, TIP_NOT_REVIEWED, CONFLICT.

error.message: This period overlaps an existing one. Confirm to save it anyway

Error413.description: The body is too large (10 KB, or 2 MB for sync)

error.message: The request body is too large

Error429.description: Too many requests. Wait and retry; see the RateLimit-* headers.

error.message: Too many requests, slow down and try again shortly

Error503.description: HerCare has been switched off by the admin (FEATURE_DISABLED). Data export and erase still work.
